surface-inset.description: Inputs and wells inside a pane.

surface-hover-contrast.description: Hover wash on a bright (banner) surface.

layout-timeline-min-width.description: Narrowest timeline beside the rail and room list; below it the shell shows one pane at a time (phone layout).

layout-voice-tile-min-width.description: Narrowest video tile in a call; the stage fits as many per row as this allows.

layout-voice-stage-max-height.description: Tallest the video stage above the timeline may grow before it scrolls.

layout-settings-content-min-width.description: Narrowest settings page beside the sidebar; below it the sidebar becomes its own screen.

userbar-gap.description: Gap between the avatar and the status text.

settings-content-min-width.description: Narrowest settings page beside the sidebar; below it the sidebar becomes its own screen.
